project.name: fleet
project.summary: fleet runs many coding agents (Claude Code, Copilot CLI, agy, vibe, pi and others) side by side for one user: each agent gets a tmux window, a git worktree and a board entry, an admiral agent steers them over MCP, and a TUI overview and live wall show who needs attention. One Go binary; no server, no database: state is flock-guarded JSON under ~/.fleet.

nodes.label: CLI commands
nodes.summary: cmd/fleet: every `fleet <verb>` (spawn, ls, merge, touching, recall, graph, doctor, page, ...) is an entry in a handler table that calls into the core.

nodes.label: Agent orchestration
nodes.summary: Spawns, watches, steers and stops agents: tmux panes, tool profiles, status read from the screen, the board, and the ACP path for tools that speak it.

nodes.label: Fleet core
nodes.summary: internal/fleet: the only place that combines board, tmux and tools; spawn, send, peek, kill, resume, queue, park, merge plumbing.

nodes.label: Board
nodes.summary: ~/.fleet/board.json (flock + atomic rename) and events.jsonl: the state every other part reads.

nodes.label: tmux and panes
nodes.summary: Thin tmux adapter on fleet's own sockets, plus process-tree stop and cgroup cache drop.

nodes.label: Tool profiles
nodes.summary: Data-driven profiles per agent CLI (built-ins + ~/.fleet/tools.toml): launch and resume command lines, trust pre-marking, finding the tools' own session stores.

nodes.label: Status reading
nodes.summary: Classifies each agent (working, idle, waiting, error) from the bottom of its pane with per-tool patterns, summarises screens, and keeps it fresh in the background watcher.

nodes.label: ACP agents
nodes.summary: Agent Client Protocol client and `fleet acp-host`, which runs a tool's ACP server in the agent's window; kagent runs one in Kubernetes; rexec runs a command for a worktree on another machine.

nodes.label: Fake agent
nodes.summary: Scripted fake agent for tests and the dev loop, so no test spends tokens.

nodes.label: Admiral and MCP
nodes.summary: The admiral agent steers the fleet through fleet's MCP server; this holds the tools it calls, its memory on disk, and the text every worker is given.

nodes.label: MCP server
nodes.summary: Minimal stdio MCP server: admiral tools, peer tools for workers (fleet_report, fleet_msg_send, ...), the CLI parity table, and the injected instructions.md.

nodes.label: Admiral memory
nodes.summary: Session records, decisions.log, handoffs, the open-items queue and the waits-on-you list.

nodes.label: Playbook and rules
nodes.summary: Worker playbook by effort level (light, standard, pro) with user and repo layers, the user's standing rules, and request routes.

nodes.label: Pages
nodes.summary: Briefs rendered to one self-contained HTML page (fleet page) and the answers sent back from decision pages.

nodes.label: Agents working together
nodes.summary: What lets parallel agents avoid stepping on each other: mail and access grants, worktree overlap, ADR number claims, the code graph and recall of who changed what.

nodes.label: Mail
nodes.summary: Inter-agent mailbox, access grants and reports under ~/.fleet/mail.

nodes.label: Worktrees and merge
nodes.summary: Lists other worktrees and the files each changes (fleet touching), merge planning and conflict rules for append-only docs.

nodes.label: Code graph
nodes.summary: Builds one graphify graph per repo under ~/.fleet/graphs, rebuilt after each merge, and reads it for touching, merge --dry-run, recall and the spawn brief.

nodes.label: Recall
nodes.summary: Answers 'what was I doing on X' from fleet's own reports, notes, sessions and git, without a model; `fleet recall <file|pkg.Func>` adds who changed that code and what uses it.

nodes.label: Screens
nodes.summary: What the user looks at: the overview TUI, the live wall of agent panes, keys, colours and the browser front end.

nodes.label: Overview TUI
nodes.summary: Bubble Tea grid of agent tiles sorted by attention.

nodes.label: Wall and layout
nodes.summary: The main window: admiral, overview strip and live agent panes; all pane geometry lives in layout.

nodes.label: Keys, theme, logo
nodes.summary: The one hotkey registry, colour palettes and state glyphs, and the fleet mark.

nodes.label: Web front end
nodes.summary: fleet web: a browser view of the board beside the TUI.

nodes.label: Spend and quota
nodes.summary: What agents cost and how much quota is left: per-session spend from the tools' own files, the day ledger, and quota-aware spawning before resets.

nodes.label: Shared plumbing
nodes.summary: Logging, config, the small TOML parser, OS calls, the companion contract for external CLIs, self-update, the changelog, the browser guard and the test leak checker.

nodes.label: Build, release and site
nodes.summary: Makefile-driven checks, the public check and release lock, install scripts, examples and image builders.

nodes.label: Tests
nodes.summary: Go tests beside each package; tests use only fleet-test-* tmux sockets and the fake agent.

nodes.label: Agent CLIs
nodes.summary: Claude Code, Copilot CLI, agy, vibe, pi and the others fleet runs in tmux panes or over ACP; never installed by fleet.

nodes.label: Charm TUI libraries
nodes.summary: Bubble Tea, Lip Gloss and friends: the only third-party Go dependencies.

nodes.label: graphify
nodes.summary: Companion CLI that builds the code graph; optional.

nodes.label: GitHub
nodes.summary: Releases for self-update and gh for CI runs.

edges.label: launch in tmux
edges.description: Profiles build the command line each agent CLI is started and resumed with.

edges.label: graphify update
edges.description: Run detached after each fleet merge; output in ~/.fleet/graphs/<repo>.

edges.label: MCP tools
edges.description: The admiral and each worker call fleet over MCP (fleet mcp).
